findings.text: 为已有兼容DSH的教师和培训资料维护者，把允许的资料整理成可追问、可修订的学习草稿；场景明确而需求/学习效果未验证，见[Q01](#research-q01)。
正常卡片→对话草稿/宿主Agent→create_artifact→原资料或已有索引→独立纯文本模型请求→结构校验/工件→Client消费；有限生成不等自带通用Agent，见[Q01](#research-q01)至[Q03](#research-q03)。
统计器覆盖表列MD/JS/MJS/TS/TSX/JSX等，未计共享Office核心Python；含文档/测试/共享包，非本插件原创代码/工时。固定组件源码，聚焦正常UI→工具→原资料/既有索引→有限模型生成/引用→学习与代表Office交接/持久失败。未构建/运行目标、模型/测试/Office/媒体，不全审所有格式/共享工具/官方viewer内部、宿主安全与平台/退出；源版本不当线上统一版本。
Studio源码包0.6.2，配套Artifact Services0.3.1；bundle/Client需兼容构建加载，发布包内容/当前npm分发未本轮验证，README旧版不沿用。

| 依赖 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 兼容DSH Host/Client与Node24.18+ | 核心必需 | workspace/fs/tools/模型/技能/remote与实际Studio UI | 先核版本/构建与加载，源码client未跟踪成品，不声称安装即用 |
| Artifact Services0.3.1 | bundle必需 | 精确配套Office/媒体/转写等共享接口 | 缺失不能满足inject；不要错配README旧版或重复注册 |
| 平台Ladybug0.20.1 native | 当前模块加载需要 | 即使无索引，静态import也require平台绑定 | 缺optional native/不支持平台会throw；先准备，不以无索引绕过 |
| 允许的资料/工作区FS | 生成必需 | 范围/大小/类型受限的本地读取 | 无可引用内容拒绝，不自动放宽；核宿主真实权限 |
| 已配置模型/可外发授权 | 生成必需 | 宿主Agent及独立内容stream | 未选模型报错，不能把本地索引当生成全离线 |
| 可写数据目录/磁盘 | 保存/交互/导出必需 | artifacts.json、历史/快照和exports；索引另有workspaces | 写失败显式未落盘，备份后处理；未证跨进程强一致 |
| Office工具或共享Python | Office模式需要，quiz/卡片不需先启 | DOCX/PPTX/XLSX创建与结构检查 | 正文可保留但导出失败；按受管/共享路径分别恢复，不绕拒绝 |
| 浏览器/转换/语音等 | PDF/预览/音视频条件需要 | 实际字节预览/转换/媒体与声音 | readiness/类型有条件，缺失明确处理，不当所有平台已装 |
| 本地索引/旧检索工具开关 | 非创作前提 | 已有索引词法检索；显式开关才额外四工具 | 无索引读原文件；索引可能旧，fresh不能替代活源检查 |

| 阶段 | 钱/机器资源 | 人工与时间 | 失败/退出处理 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次 | 兼容Host/Client、native/共享包；Office/媒体另有环境资源，金额未知 | 核范围/模型/构建发行物、授权与事实小样，耗时未知 | 先公开quiz/卡片，不为试用全装媒体 |
| 持续 | 宿主决策＋独立生成token、状态/快照/输出磁盘、可选媒体算力 | 核答案/引用、改资料与索引、审核导出 | 会话token选项/idle不是现金或总时长cap |
| 失败恢复 | 重生成可能再次收费；合格shared-office仅重导出 | 保草稿/历史，分权限、模型截断、格式和写盘故障 | 受管Office失败不能不受管绕过；旧成功回显带warning |
| 退出 | 快照/导出/原件保留占磁盘，外部模型费已发生 | 备份需要的原文件与成果、撤插件配置、核进程/残留 | 删除仅标记，close取消等待非全回滚，未验完整卸载 |
已有兼容环境且允许外发公开小资料者，可试quiz/卡片并人工核答案；不直接学生评分/大批生成，不强开Office/媒体，见[Q04](#research-q04)/[Q05](#research-q05)。

| 层次 | 材料支持的效果 | 未知/验收 |
|---|---|---|
| 已核源码 | 统一资料创作/修订/交互和代表真实文件链 | 不把共享能力全算本插件原创 |
| 作者/接口声明 | 多格式、引用/学习反馈与兼容平台 | 版本README旧，引用/结构/评分界限见Q02/Q03 |
| 独立结果 | 本轮无实际生成/教师或学习任务对照 | 支持率、错误/漏项、总准备成本与学生独立结果 |
已有串行/原子保存、条件轮末修订和最后成功回显、保存正文后的合格导出恢复/权限拒绝边界；不是跨进程事务/教学真值/全部入口统一审批。索引fresh与file_实时检查需区别，见[Q02](#research-q02)/[Q03](#research-q03)。
当前同会话到学习草稿/真实工件的管理链、条件轮末最终版与失败历史/只重导出机制，比散落聊天复制多了可管理交接。共享服务属直接依赖，输出正确与教学效果仍未证，见[Q01](#research-q01)/[Q03](#research-q03)。
引用可选且只验ID/结构；索引fresh比较当前索引而非实时重读文件，合法答案索引也不证答案真值。无索引创作仍静态加载Ladybug native；正常工具/直启RPC权限路径不同，见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。
先补索引与活文件对齐，再在现有快照/修订上核条目级事实和答案支持/教师确认，三组对照误用与总投入；现有能力已等效就否定，见[Q05](#research-q05)。

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)/[Q02](#research-q02)资料生成/学习交互是熟知组合novelty25%超纯列表0%，未见已核范围新算法证据阻50%；[Q03](#research-q03)代次/轮末/原子写/真实工件与条件恢复mechanism75%超单次RAG50%，宿主/多进程及语义真值阻100%；独立共享服务但根仍深耦DSH/typert/native，transfer25%超仅prompt0%，跨宿主独立适配未证阻50%；统一组织/恢复simplification50%超复制粘贴25%，运行时/核验投入阻75%。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)至[Q03](#research-q03)资料到学习草稿workflow50%超单聊天25%，实际教师/独立学习结果阻75%；实际文件/交互与修订交接delivery75%超只文本50%，跨格式/发行物/学生验收未证阻100%；兼容DSH专业用户reach25%超仅作者0%，native/客户端与真实需求阻50%；条件重导免重复内部生成及复用服务economics25%超无恢复机制0%，[Q04](#research-q04)总费用/核验无净对照阻50%。

recommendation.reason: 已有兼容DSH、配套运行时和模型，且允许发送公开小资料并能核答案的教师或培训资料维护者，可用 Knowledge Studio 先生成测验或卡片并管理修订与复习草稿。相比普通创作后手工复制制卡，源码支持同会话的范围读取、来源快照、交互回存和成果交接，但结构合法、索引新鲜度或生成答案索引都不能替代事实核验与独立学习结果。若来源与现文件不符、题目或答案无法由原文支持、费用权限超出允许范围，或审核返工高于原办法，应停止扩展生成，保留原资料和需要的成果后退回普通技能与人工制卡。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)公开资料学习草稿50%超泛教育AI25%，教师真实频率/需求与学习任务对照阻75%。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)/[Q03](#research-q03)交互/同轮历史/真实文件50%超只prompt25%，普通技能/手工替代和事实支持未证阻75%。

evidence.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)至[Q04](#research-q04)正常caller/callee、索引反证/权限导出/持久化源码50%超README25%，未构建运行/独立教师结果阻75%。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04)已有环境/公开quiz卡片可不先启Office媒体，有限试用50%超只能大批付费25%，native/Host兼容、外发和人工审核/撤装未知阻75%。

data.reports:
# EduWork Knowledge Studio > DSH工作区资料创作插件，将对话生成接到Studio修订、学习交互与真实文件交接；引用合法/快照状态和生成答案仍需独立核验。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[ECNU/EduWork](https://github.com/ECNU/EduWork) - **版本号**：0.6.2（Studio包；配套Artifact Services0.3.1）（[固定提交 a43a4d424c9d25668589dfe94a3871318ce299ff](https://github.com/ECNU/EduWork/tree/a43a4d424c9d25668589dfe94a3871318ce299ff)） - **版本日期**：2026-10-28（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定源码闭合插件/Client构建接线、普通卡片到工具、资料/模型/引用/交互及代表Office/持久失败路径。未构建安装或运行模型/Office/媒体/宿主，不全审所有共享服务；限公开小资料、人工核答案的条件试用。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：为已有兼容DSH的教师和培训资料维护者，把允许的资料整理成可追问、可修订的学习草稿；场景明确而需求/学习效果未验证，见[Q01](#research-q01)。 - **亮点**：当前同会话到学习草稿/真实工件的管理链、条件轮末最终版与失败历史/只重导出机制，比散落聊天复制多了可管理交接。共享服务属直接依赖，输出正确与教学效果仍未证，见[Q01](#research-q01)/[Q03](#research-q03)。 - **思考**：引用可选且只验ID/结构；索引fresh比较当前索引而非实时重读文件，合法答案索引也不证答案真值。无索引创作仍静态加载Ladybug native；正常工具/直启RPC权限路径不同，见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。 - **建议**：先补索引与活文件对齐，再在现有快照/修订上核条目级事实和答案支持/教师确认，三组对照误用与总投入；现有能力已等效就否定，见[Q05](#research-q05)。 采用建议：已有兼容环境且允许外发公开小资料者，可试quiz/卡片并人工核答案；不直接学生评分/大批生成，不强开Office/媒体，见[Q04](#research-q04)/[Q05](#research-q05)。 ## 核心贡献 当前同会话到学习草稿/真实工件的管理链、条件轮末最终版与失败历史/只重导出机制，比散落聊天复制多了可管理交接。共享服务属直接依赖，输出正确与教学效果仍未证，见[Q01](#research-q01)/[Q03](#research-q03)。 ## 关键质疑 引用可选且只验ID/结构；索引fresh比较当前索引而非实时重读文件，合法答案索引也不证答案真值。无索引创作仍静态加载Ladybug native；正常工具/直启RPC权限路径不同，见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 先补索引与活文件对齐，再在现有快照/修订上核条目级事实和答案支持/教师确认，三组对照误用与总投入；现有能力已等效就否定，见[Q05](#research-q05)。 先核普通卡片真实工具/结果与file_、旧索引、错误但合法引用、模型截断和导出拒绝，再三组对照条目支持/教师成本与学习结果，见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q05](#research-q05)。 ## 场景与替代办法 为已有兼容DSH的教师和培训资料维护者，把允许的资料整理成可追问、可修订的学习草稿；场景明确而需求/学习效果未验证，见[Q01](#research-q01)。 与同宿主普通创作技能/共享Office及手工制卡比，已核增量为来源范围、成果交互/修订/快照与文件交接；没有独立任务净收益，不重复计入底座Agent/官方格式处理，见[Q01](#research-q01)/[Q05](#research-q05)。 ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：核正常UI/工具/资料生成/引用/实际工件与失败边界，判断受控试用及条目级支持验证增量。 ### Q01 · 知识创作是什么组件，正常界面到生成工具如何接通？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、功能与机制、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 本对象是@eduwork/dsh-knowledge-studio这个DSH Host＋Client插件，entry_type=plugin，不是整个EduWork桌面、独立Agent或只有技能。当前package声明Studio0.6.2并精确依赖共享Artifact Services0.3.1；README仍写0.6.0/0.3.0，不能沿用为当前包版本，也不据源码号声称npm发行物已发布可用。Node要求24.18+，DSH peer从0.2.1-rc.2到0.3前；无强制机构服务的inject声明，不把整发行版账号当本组件必需。 bundle patch先加载共享成果服务再Studio。实际Host main为lib/index.js，Service注入workspace/fs/settings/skills/llm/agents和artifactServices，创建manager/ArtifactEngine，默认安装一个knowledge_studio_create_artifact工具与可禁用Skill；indexedRetrievalTools只有显式true才另注册四个旧检索工具。八种kind是同一生成工具的分支，不是八个独立模型工具。 Client不是只有export声明：tsdown把src/client/index.tsx编为lib/client.js；源码apply实际mount remote并注入knowledgeStudio，按宿主layout能力选择官方sidebar tab/slot或旧details/overlay入口。固定git树未跟踪生成后的lib/client.js，故已核是源码构建/挂载接线，未验证编译产物或安装后的UI。正常artifact卡片先把人可读请求放入对话草稿并submit，要求按knowledge-studio技能创建；宿主Agent是否正确调用仍是运行前提。真正工具execute用当前Agent cwd解析工作区→artifacts.start→wait；另有RPC invokeStudio的直启分支，不能拿备用RPC冒充所有正常点击。 为已使用兼容DSH的教师/培训资料维护者，把允许的资料组织成可管理、可追问、可下载的学习草稿；真实需求强度、教师节时与学习效果未验证。逐操作能力表见[能力清单](#能力清单)，共享服务附带工具不都算本插件新增。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[packages/dsh-knowledge-studio/package.json:1-23](https://github.com/ECNU/EduWork/blob/a43a4d424c9d25668589dfe94a3871318ce299ff/packages/dsh-knowledge-studio/package.json#L1-L23) 包0.6.2/main/client等出口。

        "answer": "生成开始先保存running任务并绑定AbortController；得到正文/引用后先保存ready内容再尝试Office或媒体文件，最后才置completed，异常则failed/cancelled并保留partial draft/代次等。ArtifactStore在实例内串行变更，临时0600新文件+rename原子替换；重启把running/queued转interrupted，不自动重跑模型。写盘失败的terminal会明确persistenceError而非假称已落盘；这不证明多进程合并、磁盘灾难恢复或所有子进程都终止。\n\n若execution提供session.snapshotEvents且有本轮turn/start，retryArtifactId/targetKey可把同轮同kind成品修订放同一id并保attempts；session turn/end hook等待对应任务再settle，presentArtifact在open期间显示等待轮末，最后修改失败时可回显此前成功版并给warning。缺该turn接口/直接RPC时不能概括同样受轮末门控；这也不保证宿主自动修好内容。Client确轮询readArtifact并传给StudioArtifact/ArtifactPanel，答案/翻卡等交互经remote回存，而非只服务端元数据。\n\nreport/table/slides的Office分支在有Agent和相应工具时走ctx.tools.execute create→validate→inspect，携parent/agent/signal，并核实际输出realpath在工作区再复制；工具拒绝会throw，调用者不会把该异常吞成不受管Python回退。缺工具或没有execution的直启路径才可返回null而用共享exportDocument→runOffice→真实Python execFile，故不能称所有入口都有相同工具审批。结构验证/inspect不证明内容事实或渲染保真。\n\n预览已有Office不重跑模型：原生入口交所属Session文件地址给官方Sidebar，兼容服务renderOfficePreview读取实际文件字节并按hash缓存；PDF有明确两路径：仅officeFormatFor(kind)有值且officialOfficeRuntime()条件成立时，取已保存Office（没有则先生成该Office）交convertOfficeFile；转换异常清临时目录后重抛，不自动换浏览器。未进入该条件分支时，调用exportDocument(...,html)，再由Chromium setContent/page.pdf打印。HTML子路径对幻灯片/已有Office可读取实际Office预览，其他则从保存的报告正文或contentMarkdown重组HTML。因此不能泛称PDF始终直接转换原Office或始终同一渲染器；分页、字体、外部编辑保留和版式/内容一致性均未实测。合格shared-office导出失败可校验保存内容/引用集合hash后只重导出，office-tools失败禁止用该入口绕权限；这不是再次核活文件或所有失败都能无费恢复。删除是标deletedAt，未删除导出文件；close发送abort并等待本插件任务，已耗模型费/已写工件不会自动回滚。",

报告、表格和幻灯片的结构检查及 PDF 转换与对话共用官方组件，PDF 从实际保存的 Office 文件生成。宿主依赖和旧格式支持见[Office 工作流](packages/artifact-services/docs/OFFICE_PROCESSING.md)。\n\n从官方侧栏「开始」页打开 Studio。宿主管理标签页、折叠和全屏状态；Studio Profile；启用步骤、独立 Web 启动及运行环境配置见 [使用指南](docs/USAGE.md)。加载 Studio bundle 时会注册共享服务；不要另装第二份共享服务或旧 Office 执行插件。\n\n成果完成与失败可接入宿主的[插件通知协议](https://github.com/ECNU/EduWork/blob/main/docs/PLUGIN_NOTIFICATIONS.md)。通知服务可选，未安装时仍可使用 Studio；成果状态和点击导航由 Studio 自己管理。\n\nOffice 需要另行准备 Python 3.12+ 和共享包的 align=\"center\"><strong>基于 DSH 的教育发行版。</strong><br><sub>机构接入 · 资料创作 · 插件与技能</sub></p>\n\n<div align=\"center\">\n\n[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-3DA66B?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![DSH: 0.2.1-rc.3](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.1--rc.3-4169e1?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/releases/tag/dsh-v0.2.1-rc.3) [![Platform: Windows x64 / macOS arm64 / x64](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20x64%20%7C%20macOS%20arm64%20%2F%20x64-9f2636?style=flat-square)](#安装与使用)\n\n**简体中文** | [English](README_EN.md)\n\n[项目官网](https://ecnu.github.io/EduWork/) · [预装插件](#随包插件) · [安装与使用](#安装与使用) · [详细文档](#详细文档) · [Roadmap 讨论](https://github.com/ECNU/EduWork/issues/95)\n\n</div>\n\nEduWork 基于 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)，为教学、科研与办公组合插件、技能和桌面运行环境。围绕本机资料开展对话、创作和学习，可以连接个人模型服务，也可以使用兼容的学校或企业账号登录。\n\n![EduWork 工作区：对话、资料与成果预览](docs/images/workspace.png)\n\n## 从 DSH 到学校发行版\n\nDSH 提供 Agent 运行时与插件体系；EduWork 复用上游的会话、工具、浏览器与文件能力，维护教育场景的公共组合。学校与机构通过配置和插件接入自己的模型、业务服务和品牌。[EduWork@ECNU](https://github.com/ECNU/EduWork-ECNU) 是其中一个实践。\n\n## 随包插件\n\n下面的插件随公版客户端预装，无需逐个安装。点击名称查看使用方法、服务要求与兼容范围。\n\n<a id=\"knowledge-studio\"></a>\n\n<!-- BEGIN GENERATED PLUGINS -->\n| 插件 | 能做什么 |\n| --- | --- |\n| [机构登录与模型接入](packages/dsh-oidc/README.md) | 通过浏览器登录兼容的机构网关，发现模型并自动续期。支持 LiteLLM OAuth 与实验性 oidc-llm 接入。 |\n| [Knowledge Studio](packages/dsh-knowledge-studio/README.md) | 把资料变成报告、演示、思维导图、测验与闪卡；配套成果服务提供 Office 预览和媒体制作，与对话共用。 |\n| [选段批注](packages/dsh-annotation/README.md) | 选中回复片段添加批注，保留来源编号，多条一起发送；复用 DSH 的输入框与草稿。 |\n| [文献检索](packages/dsh-literature/README.md) | 检索 DBLP、arXiv 文献，获取 BibTeX 与可用全文，把研究资料接入后续任务。 |\n| [本地记忆](packages/dsh-memory/README.md) | 管理本地记忆、检索历史对话，让后续任务接得上已有背景。记忆在本机管理。 |\n| [邮件助手](packages/dsh-mail/README.md) | 连接自己的邮箱，通过 IMAP 读取邮件，经授权通过 SMTP 发送，结合任务处理日常沟通。 |\n| [桌面宠物](packages/dsh-desktop-pet/README.md) | 用可选形象展示任务与通知状态，在设置中开启。独立 npm 插件，需要 EduWork 桌面桥接。 |\n| [远程访问](packages/dsh-remote-access/README.md) | 配对后从其他终端的浏览器继续本机会话、处理授权。先部署中继并配置地址与接入 Key，再开启连接。 |\n<!-- END GENERATED PLUGINS -->\n\n插件也以独立 npm 包维护，可按各自兼容范围供其他 DSH 应用复用。外部模型、邮箱和媒体服务需自行配置；公版不附带模型额度或私人凭据。\n\n### 随包技能\n\n技能负责引导任务方法，调用插件与工具完成工作。内置文档、演示、表格、PDF、图像、语音、视频、Studio、浏览器及技能创作等指引，可在设置中启停或导入自己的技能。对话与 Studio 共用创作能力，图像和云端语音需配置相应服务。[使用指南](docs/USER_GUIDE.md) · [媒体配置](docs/MEDIA.md)\n\n## 安装与使用\n\n桌面包支持 **Windows x64**、**macOS 15+ Apple Silicon（arm64）和 Intel（x64）**。每位用户在自己的电脑上运行，普通本地使用无需额外部署 EduWork 服务端。\n\n### 1. 获取客户端\n\n从 [最新稳定版](https://github.com/ECNU/EduWork/releases/latest) 下载对应平台的桌面包：\n\n- **Windows**：下载 `setup.zip`，解压后运行安装程序，选择可写的新目录。也可下载完整 Electron ZIP，全部解压后运行 `EduWork-Electron.exe`，保留同目录资源文件。\n- **macOS**：按芯片选择 arm64 或 x64 的 DMG，将应用拖入“应用程序”后打开；也可使用对应 ZIP。首次打开的系统安全提示见 [macOS 说明](docs/MACOS.md)。\n\nRelease 中的 Source code 是源码，不是桌面安装包。从源码运行见[构建指南](docs/BUILD.md)。\n\n### 2. 连接模型\n\n| 你已有的服务 | 如何开始 |\n| --- | --- Never unlink the destination\n// to work around Windows readers, antivirus or indexing handles.\nexport async function writeAtomicJSON(path,state,{renameFile=rename,wait=sleep}={}) {\n const temporary=`${path}.${process.pid}.${randomUUID()}.tmp`\n try {\n  await mkdir(dirname(path),{recursive:true})\n  await writeFile(temporary,JSON.stringify(state,null,2)+'\\n',{encoding:'utf8',mode:0o600,flag:'wx'})\n  for(let attempt=0;;attempt++) {\n   try {await renameFile(temporary,path);break}\n   catch(error) {\n    if(!['EPERM','EBUSY','EACCES'].includes(error.code)||attempt>=7)throw error\n    await wait(Math.min(50*2**attempt,400))\n   }\n  }\n } catch(cause) {\n  throw Object.assign(new Error(`Studio 成果记录保存失败（${cause.code||'IO'}），原文件已保留；请稍后重试。`,{cause}),{code:cause.code||'STUDIO_PERSISTENCE',persistenceFailure:true})\n } finally {await unlink(temporary).catch(()=>{})}\n}\n"

      "content": "import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'\nimport { scanWorkspace } from './indexer.js'\nimport { parseDocument, isSupportedPdfPath } from './parser.js'\nimport { parsePdfBytes } from './pdf.js'\nimport { tokenize } from './tokenizer.js'\n\nconst hash = value => createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex')\n\n// Bounded, ephemeral file reads through the host FS. No database or model call.\nexport async function basicEvidence(fs, workspace, query, { signal, limit = 32, pathPrefix = '' } = {}) {\n  const scan = await scanWorkspace(fs, workspace, { signal, maxReadDocuments: 48,\n    pathPrefix, maxFiles: 2000, maxTextFileBytes: 256 * 1024, maxPdfFileBytes: 8 * 1024 * 1024 })\n  const terms = new Set(tokenize(query))\n  const candidates = []\n  for (const document of scan.documents) {\n    const parsed = document.parsed ?? parseDocument({ path: document.path, text: document.text })\n    for (const section of parsed.sections) for (const chunk of section.chunks) {\n      const revisionHash = hash(document.text ?? JSON.stringify(parsed))\n      const excerptHash = hash(chunk.content)\n      const id = hash(`${workspace.id}\\0${document.path}\\0${revisionHash}\\0${chunk.lineStart}\\0${chunk.pageStart}\\0${excerptHash}`)\n      const tokens = new Set(tokenize(`${document.path} ${section.title} ${chunk.content}`))\n      candidates.push({ ...chunk, path: document.path, heading: section.title,\n        id: `file_${id}`, chunkId: `file_${id}`, evidenceId: `file_${id}`,\n        revisionHash, excerptHash, score: [...terms].filter(term => tokens.has(term)).length })\n    }\n  }\n  return candidates.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score).slice(0, limit)\n}\n\n// Revalidate a persisted file citation without relying on an ephemeral index.\nexport async function verifyBasicCitation(fs, workspace, citation) {\n  try {\n    const root = await fs.resolve(workspace.path)\n    const target = await fs.resolve(citation.path, { cwd: workspace.path })\n    if (!fs.contains(root, target)) return false\n    const stat = await fs.stat(target)\n    const pdf = isSupportedPdfPath(citation.path)\n    if (stat?.type !== 'file' || stat.size > (pdf ? 8 * 1024 * 1024 : 256 * 1024)) return false\n    const text = pdf ? null : await fs.readText(target)\n    const parsed = pdf ? await parsePdfBytes({ path: citation.path, bytes: await fs.readBytes(target, undefined, 8 * 1024 * 1024) }) : null\n    return hash(text ?? JSON.stringify(parsed)) === citation.revisionHash\n  } catch { return false }\n}\n"

This is eligibility only; the host revalidates the\n// full saved content/citation set and its checkpoint hash before any file work.\nexport const officeFormatFor = kind => ({report:'docx',slides:'pptx',table:'xlsx'})[kind]\nexport function isLegacyOfficeExportFailure(artifact) {\n  if(artifact.exportState)return false\n  if(artifact.generation?.finishKind!=='stop'||artifact.status!=='failed')return false\n  if(!String(artifact.message||'').startsWith('office operation failed: '))return false\n  try {\n    const failure=JSON.parse(artifact.message.slice('office operation failed: '.length))\n    return failure.ok===false&&failure.operation==='create'&&['text_too_long','invalid_metric','metric_value_unreadable'].includes(failure.error?.code)\n  }catch{return false}\n}\nexport function canRetryOfficeExport(artifact) {\n  return Boolean(artifact&&!artifact.deletedAt&&officeFormatFor(artifact.kind)&&['failed','interrupted','cancelled'].includes(artifact.status)&&artifact.content&&\n    ((artifact.exportState?.version===1&&artifact.exportState.validatedContentHash&&artifact.exportState.phase!=='complete'&&!artifact.exportState.blocked&&artifact.exportState.provider!=='office-tools')||isLegacyOfficeExportFailure(artifact)))\n}\n"

      "path": "packages/dsh-knowledge-studio/lib/generation-policy.js",
      "content": "// Studio uses the same exact model route and user choices as the conversation.\n// An adapter default is not a universal context limit or a plugin-owned cap.\nexport async function generationPolicy(ctx, selection, sessionId, signal, explicitMaxTokens) {\n  const request = sessionId ? ctx.agents?.get(sessionId)?.session?.requestHeader()?.config : undefined\n  const selected = request && (!request.provider || request.provider === selection.provider) && (!request.model || request.model === selection.model) ? request : undefined\n  const info = await ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo?.(selection.provider, selection.model, signal)\n  signal?.throwIfAborted()\n  const options = {}\n  const requestedCap = explicitMaxTokens ?? selected?.maxTokens\n  if (requestedCap !== undefined) {\n    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(requestedCap) || requestedCap <= 0) throw new Error('模型输出预算必须是正整数')\n    options.maxTokens = requestedCap\n  }\n  const effort = selected?.reasoningEffort\n  // Routes such as a model with thinking but no effort controls must receive\n  // no stale effort left by an older session or a different model.\n  if (effort && info?.reasoning?.efforts?.some(item => item.id === effort)) options.reasoningEffort = effort\n  return {\n    options,\n    generation: {\n      ...selection,\n      maxTokens: options.maxTokens ?? info?.defaultMaxTokens ?? null,\n      reasoningEffort: options.reasoningEffort ?? info?.reasoning?.defaultEffort ?? null,\n      budgetSource: options.maxTokens !== undefined ? 'explicit' : 'model-default',\n    },\n  }\n}\n\nexport function outputLimitError(partialText, generation) {\n  const budget = generation.maxTokens ? `（本次模型配置为 ${generation.maxTokens} tokens）` : ''\n  const progress = partialText ? '已保留可见草稿，可查看后重试生成。' : '本次尚未形成可见正文，可重试生成。'\n  const error = new Error(`模型达到本次输出长度上限${budget}，成果尚未完成。${progress}这不是资料上下文容量限制。`)\n  error.code = 'STUDIO_OUTPUT_LIMIT'\n  error.partialText = partialText\n  error.generation = { ...generation, finishKind: 'max-tokens' }\n  return error\n}\n"

      "content": "import { BlockAssembler, createUserMessage } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'\nimport { generationPolicy, outputLimitError } from './generation-policy.js'\n\nfunction diagnostic(error) {\n  return String(error?.message ?? error).replace(/Bearer\\s+\\S+/gi, 'Bearer [redacted]').replace(/https?:\\/\\/\\S+/g, '[endpoint]').slice(0, 800)\n}\n\nfunction modelSelection(ctx, sessionId) {\n  const agent = sessionId ? ctx.agents?.get(sessionId) : null\n  const request = agent?.session?.requestHeader()?.config\n  const fallback = ctx.agentDefaultModel?.currentSelection?.()\n  const provider = request?.provider ?? fallback?.provider\n  const model = request?.model ?? fallback?.model\n  return provider && model ? { provider, model } : null\n}\n\nasync function generateText(ctx, { sessionId, system, prompt, signal, maxTokens, purpose = 'knowledge-studio', idleTimeoutMs = 90_000, preparedGeneration }) {\n  const selection = preparedGeneration?.selection ?? modelSelection(ctx, sessionId)\n  if (!selection || !ctx.llm?.stream) throw new Error('No DSH model is available for Studio generation')\n  if (!Number.isFinite(idleTimeoutMs) || idleTimeoutMs <= 0) throw new Error('Invalid model stream idle timeout')\n  const controller = new AbortController()\n  const abort = () => controller.abort(signal?.reason ?? new Error('Studio generation cancelled'))\n  if (signal?.aborted) abort()\n  else signal?.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true })\n  let timer\n  const activity = () => {\n    clearTimeout(timer)\n    timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(Object.assign(new Error('模型服务长时间没有返回内容，本次生成已中断，请稍后重试。'), { code: 'STUDIO_MODEL_IDLE' })), idleTimeoutMs)\n  }\n  const assembler = new BlockAssembler()\n  let generation\n  activity()\n  try {\n    const policy = preparedGeneration?.policy ?? await generationPolicy(ctx, selection, sessionId, controller.signal, maxTokens)\n    controller.signal.throwIfAborted()\n    const { options } = policy\n    generation = policy.generation\n    activity()\n    let terminalReceived = false\n    const messages = [createUserMessage({\n      content: [{ type: 'text', text: prompt }],\n      source: { kind: 'plugin', plugin: 'dsh-knowledge-studio' },\n    })]\n    for await (const chunk of ctx.llm.stream({ ...selection, ...options, messages, system, sessionId, purpose, signal: controller.signal })) {\n      controller.signal.throwIfAborted()\n      activity()\n      if (chunk.type === 'finish') terminalReceived = true\n      assembler.push(chunk)\n    }\n    controller.signal.throwIfAborted()\n    const finish = assembler.finish\n    if (['error', 'aborted'].includes(finish?.kind)) throw Object.assign(new Error(`Studio model failed: ${diagnostic(finish.failure?.message ?? finish.failure ?? finish.kind)}`), { code: finish.kind === 'aborted' ? 'STUDIO_MODEL_ABORTED' : finish.failure?.code })\n    const blocks = assembler.blocks()\n    if (blocks.some(block => block.type === 'tool-call')) throw new Error('Studio generation must return text only')\n    const text = blocks.filter(block => block.type === 'text').map(block => block.text).join('\\n').trim()\n    if (finish?.kind === 'max-tokens') throw outputLimitError(text, generation)\n    if (!terminalReceived) throw Object.assign(new Error('模型连接结束时没有返回完成标记，成果尚未完成。'), { code: 'STUDIO_STREAM_INTERRUPTED' })\n    if (!text) throw Object.assign(new Error(blocks.some(block => block.type === 'reasoning')\n      ? '模型已结束，但只返回了推理内容，没有生成正文。请重试生成；这不表示资料上下文或输出额度已耗尽。'\n      : '模型已结束，但没有返回正文。请重试生成；这不表示资料上下文或输出额度已耗尽。'), { code: 'STUDIO_EMPTY_OUTPUT' })\n    return { text, selection, generation: { ...generation, finishKind: finish.kind, ...(assembler.usage ? { usage: assembler.usage } : {}) } }\n  } catch (error) {\n    const failure = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error))\n    const partialText = assembler.blocks().filter(block => block.type === 'text').map(block => block.text).join('\\n').trim()\n    if (partialText && !failure.partialText) failure.partialText = partialText\n    if (generation && !failure.generation) failure.generation = { ...generation,\n      finishKind: signal?.aborted ? 'aborted' : assembler.finish?.kind ?? 'error',\n      hasReasoning: assembler.blocks().some(block => block.type === 'reasoning'),\n      ...(assembler.usage ? { usage: assembler.usage } : {}),\n    }\n    throw failure\n  } finally {\n    clearTimeout(timer)\n    signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort)\n  }\n}\n\nfunction citationSnapshot(evidence) {\n  return {\n    evidenceId: evidence.evidenceId,\n    chunkId: evidence.chunkId,\n    path: evidence.path,\n    heading: evidence.heading,\n    locator: evidence.locator,\n    pageStart: evidence.pageStart,\n    pageEnd: evidence.pageEnd,\n    lineStart: evidence.lineStart,\n    lineEnd: evidence.lineEnd,\n    excerpt: evidence.content.slice(0, 500),\n    excerptHash: evidence.excerptHash,\n    revisionHash: evidence.revisionHash,\n    fresh: true,\n  }\n}\n\nexport { citationSnapshot, generateText, modelSelection }\n"

      "content": "import { Remote, TypertRemoteService } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol'\nimport { ArtifactEngine } from './artifacts.js'\nimport { StudioRegistry } from './capabilities.js'\nimport { KnowledgeIndexManager } from './manager.js'\nimport { Config, liveSettings, KnowledgeStudioSettingsSchema, mergeDefaultSettings, SETTINGS_NAMESPACE, validateSettings } from './settings.js'\nimport { installKnowledgeStudioSkill } from './skill.js'\nimport { installKnowledgeStudioTools } from './tools.js'\nimport { mediaParameters } from './capabilities.js'\nimport { installStudioNotifications } from './notifications.js'\nimport {StudioUIPreferences} from './ui-preferences.js'\n\nexport const name = 'dsh-knowledge-studio'\nconst initializers = []\n\nexport class KnowledgeStudioService extends TypertRemoteService {\n  static Config = Config\n  static inject = ['tools', 'workspaceRegistry', 'fs', 'settings', 'skills', 'llm', 'agents', 'agentDefaultModel', 'artifactServices']\n\n  constructor(ctx, config = {}) {\n    super(ctx, 'knowledgeStudio')\n    this.settingsScope = typeof ctx.settings.register === 'function'\n      ? ctx.settings.register(SETTINGS_NAMESPACE, KnowledgeStudioSettingsSchema, {\n        base: mergeDefaultSettings(config), applies: 'live', validate: validateSettings,\n      })\n      : { get: () => liveSettings(config) }\n    this.manager = new KnowledgeIndexManager(ctx, config)\n    this.mediaProviders = ctx.artifactServices.media\n    this.artifacts = new ArtifactEngine(ctx, this.manager, {...config,mediaProviders:this.mediaProviders})\n    this.registry = new StudioRegistry()\n    this.uiPreferences = new StudioUIPreferences(config.uiPreferencesPath)\n    installStudioNotifications(ctx, this)\n    installKnowledgeStudioTools(ctx, this.manager, this.artifacts,{indexedRetrievalTools:config.indexedRetrievalTools===true})\n    if(config.skills!==false) {\n      const disposeSkill = installKnowledgeStudioSkill(ctx)\n      ctx.effect(() => disposeSkill, 'dsh-knowledge-studio: bundled skill')\n    }\n    ctx.effect(() => async () => {\n      await this.artifacts.close()\n      await this.manager.close()\n    }, 'dsh-knowledge-studio: close tasks and local stores')\n    for (const initialize of initializers) initialize.call(this)\n  }\n\n  settings() { return this.settingsScope.get() }\n  readUIPreferences() { return this.uiPreferences.read() }\n  setUIOpenPreference(open) { return this.uiPreferences.set(open) }\n\n  workspace(workspaceId) {\n    const workspace = this.ctx.workspaceRegistry.get(workspaceId)\n    if (!workspace) throw new Error(`Unknown DSH workspace: ${workspaceId}`)\n    return workspace\n  }\n\n  async snapshot(workspace) {\n    return {\n      id: String(workspace.id), title: workspace.title, path: workspace.path,\n      capabilities: await this.listCapabilities(),\n      artifacts: await this.artifacts.list(workspace.id),\n    }\n  }\n\n  async workspaceForPath(path) {\n    const workspace = await this.ctx.workspaceRegistry.resolveByPath(String(path ?? await this.ctx.artifactServices.ready\n    const media=await this.mediaProviders.describe()\n    const runtime=await this.ctx.artifactServices.mediaReadiness()\n    const ...cap,available:runtime.available&&(cap.id==='video'||hasSpeech),\n      unavailableReason:!runtime.available?runtime.reason:cap.id==='audio'&&!hasSpeech?'没有可用音色，请先准备本机语音或选择已配置的语音服务。':undefined,\n      parameters:[...cap.parameters,...mediaParameters(cap.id,media)],\n    }:cap)\n  }\n\n  registerSpeechProvider(provider) {return this.mediaProviders.registerSpeech(provider)}\n  registerBackgroundMusic(track) {return this.mediaProviders.registerMusic(track)}\n\n  registerStudioCapability(capability, execute) {\n    return this.registry.register(capability, execute)\n  }\n\n  async readEvidence(workspaceId, evidenceId) {\n    return { workspaceId, evidence: await this.manager.readEvidence(this.workspace(workspaceId), evidenceId) }\n  }\n\n  async invokeStudio(workspaceId, return capability.execute({ ctx: this.ctx, workspace, parameters: parameters ?? {}, sessionId, manager: this.manager })\n    }\n    if (capability.execution === 'conversation') {\n      return {       "content": "import { relative, sep } from 'node:path'\nimport { isSupportedDocumentPath, isSupportedPdfPath } from './parser.js'\nimport { parsePdfBytes } from './pdf.js'\n\nconst DEFAULT_IGNORED_DIRECTORIES = new Set([\n  '.git', '.hg', '.svn', '.dsh', '.studio', '.artifacts', '.ecnu-agent',\n  'node_modules', '.venv', 'venv', '__pycache__', 'site-packages',\n  '.tox', '.nox', '.pytest_cache', '.mypy_cache', '.ruff_cache',\n  'dist', 'build', 'coverage', '.next', '.nuxt', '.cache',\n])\n\n// Dependency lockfiles are reproducibility metadata rather than useful workspace\n// evidence. Their large, machine-generated bodies can otherwise dominate the\n// initial index while adding almost no value to Agent retrieval.\nconst DEFAULT_IGNORED_FILES = new Set([\n  'package-lock.json', 'npm-shrinkwrap.json', 'pnpm-lock.yaml',\n  'yarn.lock', 'bun.lock', 'bun.lockb',\n])\n\nfunction displayRelative(rootProcessPath, targetProcessPath) {\n  const value = relative(rootProcessPath, targetProcessPath)\n  return value.split(sep).join('/')\n}\n\nexport async function scanWorkspace(fileSystem, workspace, {\n  signal,\n  maxTextFileBytes = 1024 * 1024,\n  maxPdfFileBytes = 64 * 1024 * 1024,\n  maxFiles = 20_000,\n  maxReadDocuments = Infinity,\n  pathPrefix = '',\n  ignoredDirectories = DEFAULT_IGNORED_DIRECTORIES,\n  ignoredFiles = DEFAULT_IGNORED_FILES,\n  manifest = [],\n  indexVersion = 2,\n  onProgress,\n} = {}) {\n  const rootTarget = await fileSystem.resolve(workspace.path, { signal })\n  const rootInfo = await fileSystem.stat(rootTarget, signal)\n  if (rootInfo?.type !== 'directory') throw new Error(`Workspace directory is unavailable: ${workspace.path}`)\n  const rootProcessPath = fileSystem.processPath(rootTarget)\n  const documents = []\n  const presentPaths = []\n  const unchangedPaths = []\n  const knownByPath = new Map(manifest.map(entry => [String(entry.path).replaceAll('\\\\', '/'), entry]))\n  const skipped = { unsupported: 0, tooLarge: 0, symlink: 0, outside: 0, unreadable: 0 }\n  const stack = [{ target: rootTarget, processPath: rootProcessPath }]\n  let discovered = 0\n\n  scan: while (stack.length > 0) {\n    if (signal?.aborted) throw signal.reason ?? new Error('Workspace indexing aborted')\n    const current = stack.pop()\n    const entries = await fileSystem.listDir(current.target, signal)\n    if (entries.some(item => ['pyvenv.cfg', 'python.exe', 'python3.exe'].includes(item.name.toLowerCase()))) continue\n    for (const entry of entries) {\n      if (!fileSystem.contains(rootTarget, entry.target)) {\n        skipped.outside += 1\n        continue\n      }\n      const entryProcessPath = fileSystem.processPath(entry.target)\n      const path = displayRelative(rootProcessPath, entryProcessPath)\n      if (pathPrefix && path !== pathPrefix && !path.startsWith(pathPrefix + '/') && !(entry.type === 'directory' && pathPrefix.startsWith(path + '/'))) continue\n      const pathInfo = await fileSystem.lstat(entry.name, { cwd: current.processPath }, signal).catch(() => undefined)\n      if (pathInfo?.type === 'symlink') {\n        skipped.symlink += 1\n        continue\n      }\n      if (entry.type === 'directory') {\n        // Detect Python runtimes without discarding sibling attachments.\n        const managedEnvironment = /(?:^|\\/)\\.[^/]+\\/environments(?:\\/|$)/i.test(path)\n        if (!managedEnvironment && !ignoredDirectories.has(entry.name.toLowerCase())) stack.push({ target: entry.target, processPath: entryProcessPath })\n        continue\n      }\n      if (ignoredFiles.has(entry.name.toLowerCase())) {\n        skipped.unsupported += 1\n        continue\n      }\n      if (entry.type !== 'file' || !isSupportedDocumentPath(path)) {\n        skipped.unsupported += 1\n        continue\n      }\n      discovered += 1\n      if (discovered > maxFiles) throw new Error(`Workspace contains more than ${maxFiles} supported files; narrow the workspace or raise maxFiles`)\n      const info = entry.version ? entry : await fileSystem.stat(entry.target, signal)\n      if (!info || info.type === 'other' || info.type === 'directory') continue\n      const pdf = isSupportedPdfPath(path)\n      const sizeLimit = pdf ? maxPdfFileBytes : maxTextFileBytes\n      if (typeof info.size === 'number' && info.size > sizeLimit) {\n        skipped.tooLarge += 1\n        continue\n      }\n      presentPaths.push(path)\n      const version = String(info.version)\n      const known = knownByPath.get(path)\n      if (known?.version === version && Number(known.indexVersion) === Number(indexVersion)) {\n        unchangedPaths.push(path)\n        onProgress?.({ phase: 'scan', processed: discovered, total: null, path })\n        continue\n      }\n      try {\n        if (pdf) {\n          const bytes = await fileSystem.readBytes(entry.target, signal, sizeLimit)\n          const parsed = await parsePdfBytes({ path, bytes })\n          if (parsed.sections.length === 0) throw new Error('PDF contains no extractable text')\n          documents.push({ path, version, size: info.size, parsed })\n        } else {\n          const text = await fileSystem.readText(entry.target, signal)\n          documents.push({ path, version, size: info.size, text })\n        }\n        onProgress?.({ phase: 'scan', processed: discovered, total: null, path })\n        if (documents.length >= maxReadDocuments) break scan\n      } catch (error) {\n        if (signal?.aborted) throw signal.reason ?? error\n        skipped.unreadable += 1\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  documents.sort((left, right) => left.path.localeCompare(right.path))\n  presentPaths.sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right))\n  unchangedPaths.sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right))\n  return { documents, presentPaths, unchangedPaths, discovered, skipped }\n}\n\nexport { DEFAULT_IGNORED_DIRECTORIES, DEFAULT_IGNORED_FILES }\n"

     task.persistTimer = null\n        task.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString()\n        void this.#persistSoon(key, task, true)\n      })\n    this.#tasks.set(key, task)\n    void this.#persistSoon(key, task, true)\n    return this.task(key)\n  }\n\n  cancelIndex(workspaceId, reason = 'Cancelled by user') {\n    const key = String(workspaceId)\n    const task =       "path": "packages/dsh-knowledge-studio/skills/knowledge-studio/SKILL.md",
      "content": "---\nname: knowledge-studio\ndescription: 管理明确保存在 Studio 的成果及其修订、最终版本和下载。普通文件创作使用对应创作技能。\nwhenToUse: 用户明确要求保存到 Studio、继续修订当前 Studio 成果或查看其最终版本与下载时使用。\nuser-invocable: true\n---\n\n# Studio 成果管理\n\n使用当前对话组织成果，不创建另一套对话。普通问答正常回答；普通文件创作由对应创作技能及共享工具处理，不因用户提到报告、演示或视频就切换到 Studio。\n\n用户明确请求 Studio 成果时使用 `knowledge_studio_create_artifact`，保留用户的 kind、count、focus、pathPrefix、template、columns、style 及媒体选项。具体创作规范由共享服务提供，本技能不维护另一套设计规则。工具读取本次授权范围的原始资料；不要虚构来源或把资料读取范围描述为整个工作区。\n\n同一轮内，一个交付物及其修订保持为一个成果。使用返回的 artifactId 作为 retryArtifactId，或保留原 targetKey；即使上次已生成文件，继续改进也沿用该目标。focus 可描述新修改，来源范围保持用户要求。不要用 v1/v2/v3 新目标规避修订。只有独立请求的多个交付物使用不同目标；不同种类和后续轮次仍按工具契约分别处理。\n\nStudio 保留中间版本，在实际对话轮次结束后呈现最终版本。工具成功仅说明文件生成，按实际检查决定是否需要修订；失败时保留已生成内容并说明具体问题，不宣称成功。\n\n打开和关闭预览要保留对话。文件成果展示实际文件预览，下载提供工具返回的文件；实际页数、条目数、时长以结果为准。源码、原文件和辅助资料按用途区分，不把它们当作重复成果。\n\n集中管理技能的宿主可设置 `skills:false`，通过技能中心加载本技能；独立宿主默认注册。\n"
